title: WordPress Core: attackers can run their own code
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 12 days old, so many systems are likely still unpatched.
rankWhy: Exploitation is confirmed by an authoritative source.

category.label: Website or online store
category.why: It runs public websites, online stores or the software behind them.
category.doThis: Ask whoever runs your website or store to update it.

summary: WordPress WordPress Core contains a time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated attackers to execute code on the server during the upgrade window. This is due to predictable, web-accessible staging paths used during full-package core upgrades.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Nov 6, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.
